note: Where every shipped source file under patches/ and extensions/ came from. A rule naming a single file wins over the directory rule around it; otherwise each file matches exactly one rule. A ported rule names the upstream repository, the commit it was copied from, the repositories it came through and its licence, and every file's header names a repository of its rule, by URL. Every upstream named here must also appear in NOTICE. ProvenanceTest checks all of it. A Facebook-family repository named here also has to be allowed by sources/facebook-sources.json: one files are ported from has to be adopted there, with this rule's commit, and one a rule credits has to be adopted or a candidate. scripts/test-facebook-sources.ps1 checks that side.

For issue #65, the colour the tab bar asks for its selected tab, which draws the line over that tab and tints its icon, takes the wallpaper accent at tone 80 in dark mode; it's found through TabBarContainerLayout's colour setter and its Paint, and has exactly two readers on each build. Written for Hushfacebook: the tab Facebook opens on. No read, a read that answers no TriState or takes no ordinal right away, or a jump to the instruction after the ordinal stops patching with a message. See-through bars is written here too, with no hook of its own: Facebook's main screen, found by its manifest name as it resumes, has its top bar and tab bar found by the classes Redex keeps (NavigationBar and TabBarContainerLayout), and as each frame draws the alpha of each background that spans a bar is scaled and later given back. The patch finds the first by the one children builder loading upsell_bookmarks_key and the second by the one loading ABOVE_NATIVE, REPLACE_NATIVE and BELOW_NATIVE, and asks the extension about the group right after each reads it. A yes hands back an empty list of children, built the way the section builds its own. Each group has its own switch, and every other group is left as Facebook built it. The same folder holds Hushfacebook in the Menu: the Settings and privacy group's row list, the one list the native section builds from the session, a list and a flag, goes through the extension, which adds one row made by a factory the patch adds to Facebook's row item class, copying the first row's icon and giving it an id of its own. The Menu's row tap handler, found by the bookmarks_menu trace, opens the settings for that id, and its two loggers skip it. The Muse card is a Menu bookmark drawn with a Native Templates promotion. The patch finds its component by the kept updateState:BookmarkFolderItemComponent.updateNtContentDismissed string and, right after the render reads whether the card was dismissed, hands the answer and the bookmark to the extension, which answers yes for the bookmark named Muse, read through the kept TreeJNI.getString by the hash of name.

Written for Hushfacebook: Meta AI in Facebook's search. On Facebook 577 and 580 the patch finds three of Facebook's own decisions from kept names and literals. The results page's question of whether to add a Meta AI answer is the one boolean over FbUserSession and SearchResultsMutableContext that both callers of the meta_ai_answer_entities page builder ask first, and the patch answers no there. A page of results is built by one constructor from a list of result modules, whose role is a constant of the enum Facebook loads where it logs a failed GraphQLGraphSearchResultRole parse, and the extension leaves out Meta AI's answer and prompt roles (SEARCH_META_AI_ANSWER with its body, full body and loading state, HCM_SEARCH_META_AI_ANSWER, HCM_RELATED_META_AI_PROMPTS with its loading state, and HCM_SEARCH_AI_MODE) and keeps every other role. The page's name comes along, so the Meta AI tab's own page, the one its builder names search_meta_ai_answer_module, keeps its answer. A suggestion's flag to open Meta AI is the boolean the results router asks GraphSearchQuerySpec before it sends a search to META_AI_TAB, and the patch hands it to the extension where the suggestion parser stores it from the server's reply. The Meta AI button and the results page's Meta AI tab go around all three. The same folder holds the search screen before anything is typed: on 583 the section naming itself SearchTypeaheadPaginableSection draws each entry of null_state_results_paginating from a module tree it reads off the entry's node, and an empty row when that is null. The patch hands the node and the module to the extension right after the read and keeps its answer, which is null for the entry whose node type is SearchNullStateNativeTemplatesResult and whose rendered_modules string lists TRENDING_QUERY_SUGGESTION, the For you section, while that switch is on. With Debug logging on, the extension also logs each entry's type and module names. Search with a picture lives here too: the top bar hook hands the search button to the extension as the bar makes it, and with the switch on a long press starts the Google app's googleapp://lens link, then https://lens.google.com/ in a browser, then shows a toast when nothing answers.

Written for Hushfacebook: the order comments open in. Facebook 577 and 580 build every request for a post's comments from FetchFeedbackParams, and the request's builder sets comment_rendering_intent_token from one of its strings only when it isn't empty, so an ordinary comment sheet leaves the order to Facebook's servers. The patch finds that builder by the three variable names it reads from the params (comment_rendering_intent_token, feedback_id and focused_comment_id), finds the one params constructor that stores those three from its own parameters, and asks the extension first there. It also tells the extension first in the comment sheet's pick handler, the one method taking the session and a token that fetches UpdateCommentOrderType_FetchFeedbackQuery. The extension fills in RANKED_FILTERED_INTENT_V1, RECENT_ACTIVITY_INTENT_V1 or RANKED_UNFILTERED_CHRONOLOGICAL_REPLIES_INTENT_V1 only for a request that names no order and no focused comment, and asks again for the order picked in a post's menu until Facebook restarts.

Written for Hushfacebook: the ads in search results and on profiles. In Facebook 577 and 580 every page of search results is built by one constructor from the two builders that take a GraphQLResult and the search's SearchResultsMutableContext, and its module list is the parameter they fill with the module class's own list converter. The module class is the one holding the search result role enum it reads from result_role, and its static initializer keeps the enum's SEARCH_ADS, DEPENDENT_SEARCH_ADS, LATE_DEPENDENT_SEARCH_ADS and TOP_POSITION_SEARCH_ADS as its ads. The extension leaves a module out of the page when its role is one of those or one of the five other roles the enum names after ads. On a profile, the one method holding sponsored_timeline_stories_test_key is the timeline story component's render, which asks GraphQLStory for its sponsored_data; the extension has it draw nothing for a story that carries it.

Written for Hushfacebook: your own friends, followers and following numbers on your own profile, on this phone only. The design follows Hushfeed's local profile counts (digits only, blank keeps the real number) with no shared code. Facebook 585 lays the top of a profile out with Bloks, so the patch passes every string the Bloks node classes' getString returns to the extension, which swaps a number that sits before a friends, followers or following word. The profile screen is the class named com.facebook.timeline.fragment.ProfileFragment, whose onFragmentCreate hands the extension the screen so it can compare the profile id argument with the user id of the ViewerContext the screen holds.

Written for Hushfacebook: Home's stories row drawn as round pictures at a chosen size. Facebook 585 builds the row as Litho tiles in a list with no round variant, so the patch finds the row's render method by its trace string, reads the list view id it stores, and hands every pull to refresh wrapper a list factory returns to the extension, which clips each tile of that list to a circle and scales it.

Written for Hushfacebook: the note bubble on profile pictures. Facebook 584 lays the top of a profile out with Bloks, and its two Bloks node classes are the only concrete classes keeping their attributes in an instance SparseArray that implement getBoolean, getId, getInt, getLong, getString and put under those names. Their child getters are their instance methods taking an int and answering a List, and the main node's layout getter wraps a lone child in Collections.singletonList. The patch hands every list they return to the extension, which leaves out a node whose own string attributes name com.bloks.www.bloks.profile.note. (the bubble's tap action) or com.bloks.www.bloks.profile.async.fetch.note_bubble (the action that loads its content).

Written for Hushfacebook: Save and Download buttons in the row under a post. In Facebook 584 the row's button types come from the one static method answering a List that loads XFBUFIButtonWithFallbackOptions, and its class builds one button from a type enum, the row's state and a Map in the static method whose cases load "Save". Every list the type method returns goes through the extension, which adds the enum's SAVE constant while its switch is on. The row method seals its lists of buttons with a static call taking a List and answering an ImmutableList, the last argument of a constructor taking only ImmutableLists; before each seal a generated helper reads the post from the state the way Save's case reads it, asks the extension for a Download button, and builds it with the constructors Save's case uses: the icon from the icon enum's DOWNLOAD and the style enum's OUTLINE, the two texts, the label taking a String and a Function1, the tag, and the button.

Written for Hushfacebook: the People you may know carousel on your own profile. In Facebook 577 and 580 it is one Litho section that hands the name ProfilePeopleYouMayKnowSection to the section base class, and the profile's root section adds it only when the profile is the viewer's. The patch finds the one children builder loading that name, holds it to the section's constructor, to the base class's getLogTag() and setChildren of the builder's Children type, and to that type's public empty constructor and getChildren(), and asks the extension first there. The extension reads the name back through getLogTag() and has the builder hand back an empty Children while the People you may know switch is on.

Written for Hushfacebook: the list of more posts under a post opened from a notification. A post opened from Notifications is fetched with a query whose builder sets show_notification_permalink_footer to a MobileConfig answer, once per query variant, and with it true the server adds a footer of more posts that never passes the feed's edge filter. The patch hands each answer to the extension right where the builder reads it, and the extension answers false while the switch is on.

Written for Hushfacebook: the Find friends card where the feed runs out of friends' posts. In Facebook 583 the end of the feed is one section whose children builder adds a part for each of its pieces, and the card is the one that names itself EndOfFeedCIUnitSection. The builder reads a string off the section's settings and builds the card only when that string isn't null. The patch finds the one String field read guarded by a null check right before the card's section is created, and hands the string to the extension, which answers null while the switch is on so the card is skipped the way some feed types already skip it.

Written for Hushfacebook: posts from groups you aren't in. In Facebook 583 a post in a group carries the group as its to field, a Profile model that answers the type name Group, and that model reads viewer_join_state through getCachedEnum as an enum naming CAN_JOIN, CAN_REQUEST, MEMBER and the rest. Facebook's Join button shows for CAN_JOIN and CAN_REQUEST. The patch finds the one GraphQLStory accessor of to by its field key and type tag, the one accessor of viewer_join_state on that model by its key, and the enum by the names its static initializer holds, and fills two extension stubs with calls to them. The extension hides a post whose group answers either Join button state while the switch is on.

Written for Hushfacebook: the Related posts list under a post's buttons. In Facebook 584 it is InlineRelatedPostsPlugin, a plugin of the socket that names itself FeedStoryBelowUFIFooterSocket, and the socket's static name table names it along with the Meta AI comment summary. The patch finds that table and the socket's per-plugin check the way Hide Meta AI comment summaries does, and goes first in the check with the plugin's name from the table. The extension answers no for the Related posts plugin while the switch is on, so the socket moves on to its next plugin.

Written for Hushfacebook: the numbers on a post's Like, Comment and Share buttons. In Facebook 583 one static builder turns a button's count into its text, answering an empty text for a missing or zero count, and the Share button plugin (a kept class name) calls it. The patch finds the builder through that plugin by its shape and holds it to the empty answer and its plural lookup, then has it ask the extension first thing. While the switch is on the builder answers its own empty text, so each button shows its word.

Written for Hushfacebook: the reaction preview under a post. Two draw methods paint it, the facepile drawable that the FDSInlineReactions component's static factory returns and the onDraw of PillsBlingBarView (a kept class name). The patch finds each by its shape and has it ask the extension first thing, returning before it paints while the switch is on, so the views keep their size and their taps.

Written for Hushfacebook: the reaction preview on comments. Comments draw the same facepile drawable as posts, so the patch marks the FDSInlineReactions component a comment builds (found by the kept strings FDSComment and inline_reaction_transition_key) and copies that mark onto the drawable the one paired method makes from it, letting the drawable's draw ask the comment switch instead of the post switch.

Written for Hushfacebook: the reel ads Facebook builds as ordinary reels. In Facebook 577 and 580 the reel ad item's base class has one no-argument getter for its GraphQLStory, declared on one public interface up its supertypes that every reel item implements. The patch finds that interface and GraphQLStory's one sponsored_data accessor, and fills three extension stubs with them: whether an object is a reel item, the item's story, and the story's sponsored data. The extension drops a reel whose story carries sponsored data, the check Facebook's own Reels code makes before it shows a promotion over a reel.

Written for Hushfacebook: the floating ad button on a reel or video ad's comments. In Facebook 577, 580 and 581 the comment sheet's indicator pill numbers its eight plugins, one static method turns a number into the plugin's class name, and one static check beside it decides whether that plugin's button shows. The patch finds the name table by the Reels ad plugin's class name and the check by its shape, and has the check ask the extension first with the table's name for its number. While the switch is on, the Reels, Watch and in-stream ad buttons answer no. The pill's other plugins are Facebook's call.

Written for Hushfacebook: the Reels and Watch ad pool. In Facebook 577, 580 and 581 one class, which names itself VideoHomeSponsoredPool, extends the story pool base every client-side story loader draws from, and its two instance methods that hand back an ad edge log -WVCDF-NO-AD when the pool has none to give. The patch finds that class by the literal and those two methods by their shape, and puts a call of the extension first in each: while the switch is on they answer null, the same answer the pool gives when no slot is free, so the loader takes the next organic reel and the pool never marks an ad as used.

Written for Hushfacebook: the profile Reels tab's ad query. In Facebook 577, 580 and 581 a profile or Page's Reels tab asks for its ads with ProfileReelsAsyncAdsQuery, from one non-static void method holding that name, outside the Reels ad pool. The patch finds that method by the literal and its shape and puts a call of the extension first in it: while Hide sponsored reels is on, the method returns before it sends the query, so the tab shows only that profile's own reels.

Written for Hushfacebook: the kinds of push notification a user picks. Facebook 577 and 580 parse each push into the kept SystemTrayNotification, whose mType holds the payload's type, and read that type as a constant name of the kept NotificationType enum, before the first colon and ignoring case. Every push is posted through the one method of the kept SystemTrayNotificationManager that loads show_notif_start. The patch finds it by that literal and its kept parameter types, reads mType from the push its builder holds, and returns before anything is posted when the extension says the kind is blocked. Twelve kinds sit under six switches that all start off, and every other kind posts as Facebook posts it.

Written for Hushfacebook: the stories Facebook suggests in the Stories tray. In Facebook 577 and 580 every answer of the tray's fetch goes through the one method holding StoriesTrayLightFetchControllerQueryOps.postProcessResult, which hands the buckets as an ImmutableList to the one constructor of the tray data class it answers, and the classic tray's receiver, the one method holding optimistic_data_adapter_receives, reads that list. The patch goes first in that constructor and hands the list to the extension, which leaves out a bucket whose is_story_bucket_suggested flag is true or whose first label is SUGGESTED, the two things the tray's card reads before it writes Suggested. The flag is read through the bucket interface method the receiver calls and a tree class answers with that field's key, and the label through the one static helper answering the label enum, which also names NEWFRIEND and TRENDING, for that interface. Every other bucket and anything that isn't a bucket stays. For issue #317 Home's tray, which never goes through that constructor, is filtered in the parser that turns its buckets into tiles, and when the filter leaves its row too short to drag the extension asks the tray's scroll listener, made a Pager by the patch, for the next page the way a drag would.

Written for Hushfacebook: the ads in Marketplace's feed. Facebook 577 and 580 draw Marketplace with React Native, and its Relay queries go out through Facebook's own Networking module, whose sendRequest is the one method holding FBNetworkingModule_React_Native. It reads a POST body from the request data's string entry into a StringEntity, and the query's tracking name (RelayFBNetwork_ and the query's name) from the same data. The patch hands the body and the data to the extension right after that read. For a Marketplace query whose form-encoded variables name shouldSkipAdRequest or shouldSkipBoostedListingAdRequest at their top level as false or null, the extension sets them to true and changes nothing else. For the four ads-only queries Facebook's own Tigon callbacks list (MarketplaceHomeFeedAdsQueryRendererQuery, MarketplaceHomeFeedAdsPaginationQuery, MarketplaceHomeFeedBoostedListingAdsQuery and MarketplaceHomeFeedBoostedListingAdsPaginationQuery) it answers no body, which the module reports to JavaScript as a request it couldn't make. Marketplace search's results query names neither variable and has no ads-only query, so its ads come back among the listings. The module's answers reach JavaScript through the kept FBTigonRequest$FBTigonCallbacks: onBody hands each piece of text, a toString() result, to React Native's didReceiveNetworkIncrementalData emitter and onEOM hands a whole one to didReceiveNetworkData, each with the request's state at hand, which sendRequest builds with the tracking name in one String field. The patch reads that field and hands the text, the name and the state to the extension right where the text lands. For a Marketplace query with Search in its name, other than the typeahead and mutations, the extension reads each whole JSON payload and takes out a result whose node's type ends in AdStory or that carries a sponsored_data object with an ad id, moving later streamed and deferred indices of its list down past the ads taken out. A streamed ad gives way to a payload with null data that keeps its extensions. A payload that fails to be read goes on as it came, and after it nothing more is taken out while later indices still move. Right before onEOM reports an answer complete through didCompleteNetworkResponse, the patch asks the extension for text still waiting for a payload to finish and hands it to the incremental emitter as one last piece. A video ad that reaches Marketplace's feed anyway isn't drawn, an idea De-Vanced also has, written here from Facebook 577, 580 and 581: the two Litho components that draw one, found by the strings only each holds (its layout spec's own name, and MarketplaceVideoAdQuery with MarketplaceVideoAdComponent_), ask the extension first and return null on a yes, before the ad's video is fetched. For issue #303 a listing page's answer (MarketplacePDPSurfaceQuery on 585) goes through the same response hooks: each listing in it that carries creation_time gets how long ago and the date written after the text of its location_text, and a second copy of the listing under the same id gets the same.

Written for Hushfacebook: hiding feed posts by words the person lists. In Facebook 577 and 580 GraphQLStory has one accessor that asks getCachedModel for the field keyed message as the type tagged TextWithEntities, and GraphQLStory's own toString calls it, labels its text message.text and reads that with a static helper that is getCachedString of the key text. The patch finds that accessor and the one of attached_story as Story by their keys, holds the first to toString's reading, and fills two stubs in PostText with them. The rule runs in the shared feed guard: the extension reads both texts through the kept getCachedString after checking the model's type tag, folds them and the two bounded phrase lists with NFKC case folding, lets a keep phrase win, keeps any post whose text it can't read, and reports only counts.

Written for Hushfacebook: hiding feed posts from people, Pages and sites the person lists. In Facebook 581 GraphQLStory reads its authors with an accessor that asks getCachedModelList for the field keyed actors as the type tagged Actor, and its attachments the same way as StoryAttachment. The patch finds both by their keys and fills two stubs in PostSources. The extension reads each author's id and name and each attachment's url through the kept getCachedString, follows Facebook's l.facebook.com redirect to the site it carries, reads a shared post the same way, matches ids, whole names and sites with their subdomains against the bounded list, keeps any post it can't read, and reports only which line matched by number.

Written for Hushfacebook: a regular expression matcher for the word lists that never backtracks and counts its steps against a budget per post, and the four switches for kinds of feed post, which read an attachment's style_list and a story's text_format_metadata through accessors the Hide posts by words patch fills in. Also the reaction ceiling, which reads a story's feedback, its reactors and their count through two more accessors the patch fills in, and the topic packs the Words to hide editor adds.

Written for Hushfacebook: hiding the row of Meta AI questions under posts. In Facebook 577 and 580 one static method loads both DeepDivePillSocket and the kept class name of GenAiDeepDivePillPlugin. It loads every pill plugin's class name into one register and asks a static (model, index) -> Z check of its own class whether that plugin applies, twice per plugin, each answer in a move-result. The patch puts a call after each answer that hands the extension the answer and the name, and the extension answers no for Meta AI's plugin while its switch is on, so the socket goes on to the next plugin. A missing or doubled socket, plugin names in more than one register, or a register past v15 stops patching with a message.

Written for Hushfacebook: keeping the date on post headers. In Facebook 577 and 580 one method, the render of the post header subtitle that names itself FDSPostHeaderSubtitle, loads both in_cycling_experiment and subtitle_cycling_text_count. It works out whether the header rotates its subtitle, logs that boolean as in_cycling_experiment through String.valueOf right after the call that answers it, and then branches on it between a component that rotates the subtitle plugins' texts and the one line with the date. The patch finds that method by the two strings, checks the log's shape, and hands the answer to the extension at the log's own label, which answers no while the switch is on.

Written for Hushfacebook: a See who shared row in a post's menu. In Facebook 584 the list of people who shared a post opens through one public static (Context, GraphQLStory, String) method holding the message Activity is required to launch reshares list, and only share count rows behind a server test call it. The patch finds that launcher by its shape and message, writes the call to it into the extension's openList stub, and adds the row through the same post menu hook Download any video uses, so the list and what it shows are Facebook's.

Written for Hushfacebook: showing a post's whole text in the feed. In Facebook 584 one method takes a Spannable and a CharacterStyle, returns a Spannable, and reads the post line limit key (0x32d58eae). It calls a static helper that answers the cut text as a SpannableString, or null when the text fits, and branches on that answer right away. The patch finds that method by its shape and the key, checks there's one such call followed by its move-result and the null check, and hands the answer to the extension, which answers null while the switch is on so the whole text goes out.

Written for Hushfacebook: hiding posts you've already seen. Facebook's viewport logger saves a post's seen state in ViewportLoggingHandler.persistSeenState(session, feedUnit) once the post has left the screen after a counted view. The method keeps its name and its VPVDLOGGING trace string, and it reads the unit's id through the kept getCacheId interface method, which together find it once in 577, 580 and 581. Its one caller, the dwell runnable traced VPVDLOGGING.ViewportLoggingHandler.logFeedUnitDurationInternal, skips that call on the News Feed itself (native_newsfeed, friendly_feed and the most recent tab), so the patch hands the unit to the extension's SeenPosts in the runnable instead, on a range call right after the 250 ms dwell check and before that surface check. The extension remembers a hash of the id, and the shared feed guard drops a remembered post on a later load.

Written for Hushfacebook: the Feeds tab without its header. In Facebook 577 and 580 the Feeds tab is com.facebook.feed.fragment.FeedFiltersFragment, which keeps its member names. Its shouldInitializeNavBar answers whether the tab's chrome builds a title row, and the patch hands each answer to the extension at the return's own label, which answers no while the switch is on. Its onCreateView hands the container kept in tabBarContainer to the controller that fills and shows the filters. Right before that controller's new-instance the patch asks the extension, and on a yes puts a new container of the field's type in that register, built from the old one's Context the way the fragment builds its own, so the controller fills one that's never on screen. The fragment's feedFiltersFragmentContainerController posts a runnable Redex still names FeedFiltersFragmentContainerController$setViewPagerTopMargin$1, whose run() sets the posts' top margin to the filters' height when its boolean says they show. The patch hands that boolean to the extension between the read and the branch on it, and the extension answers no for a tab whose filters went to the container that's never on screen, so the posts start at the top.

Written for Hushfacebook: the people Facebook offers to tag while you write. In Facebook 577 and 580 every text box that can tag people is one AutoCompleteTextView subclass, found by the one performFiltering(CharSequence, int) that logs ImplicitMentionsCommonWordsFilter: JSON Parsing Exception. Right after it compares the first character of the word at the cursor with @, it reads a boolean of its MentionsAutoCompleteBehavior and returns before any lookup when the boolean is set, and both of those branches land on the lookup. The patch hands that boolean and the box (the behaviour's one field typed as the box's class) to the extension right after the read and keeps the answer in the same register. The extension answers yes while its switch is on, and closes a list of people left open by an earlier @. Words starting with @ or # never reach that read.

Written for Hushfacebook: resume long videos. FacebookAppAdsRemover describes the behavior and has no licence, so nothing was taken from its code. The patch finds FbGrootPlayer in Facebook 577 and 580 by its play trace, then its kept-name maybeTrackVideoStart and maybeTrackVideoStop, its release, bind and static seek by the trace strings they keep, its public seek as the one that hands on to that seek, its position reader as the one int method of the interface that declares isPlaying, and its length reader as the other int method its own remaining-time sum asks. VideoPlayerParams' field names come from the debug dump that reports each under its real name. The extension saves where a video longer than two minutes stopped, up to 200 of them for 30 days in a preferences file of its own, forgets one stopped near its end, and seeks back once on the video's next first start unless a seek came first or Facebook placed the start itself.

Written for Hushfacebook: Frame step, for issue #95, from Facebook 582. It finds FbGrootPlayer the way Resume long videos does and hooks its kept-name maybeTrackVideoStart and maybeTrackVideoStop, its release and its static seek, plus the one Integer-and-int boolean check that seek asks before dropping a small seek, and fills stubs with the position reader, isPlaying, the public seek and the one ViewGroup field the attach holding FbGrootPlayer.attachPlayerViewInternal writes. GestureReactionComponent, found by its constructor's name, makes a view whose constructor sets one OnTouchListener; the hook goes first in its onTouch. The extension steps a paused player under a quick side-third tap by 33 ms with BY_INITIAL_FRAME_PERFECT_SEEK (BY_USER gets 582's fast seek, which landed up to two seconds early) and turns the tap's up into a cancel. A moment later it reads where the player landed, and when that's off it asks once more with the offset taken off and keeps the offset for that player's later steps.

Written for Hushfacebook: Pinch to zoom, for issue #220, from Facebook 584. The patch puts a call first in FbFragmentActivity.dispatchTouchEvent, the override every Facebook screen shares and the one Tap to play already finds, and first in the kept-name ProfileFragment.onViewCreated(View, Bundle), which hands the extension each profile's root view. The extension zooms only in the story viewer, known by its kept class name, and under a registered profile root, since the news feed has its own pinch in the same activity. When a second finger lands on the topmost ImageView with a picture, TextureView, SurfaceView or Litho host that mounts no text and no child views, it copies that view with PixelCopy (a SurfaceView from its own surface) or draws it, lays the copy over a dim scrim in the window's decor view, follows the fingers' span and midpoint up to four times, and turns the rest of the gesture into a cancel for Facebook. Once fewer than two fingers are down the copy eases back over 200 ms to where the photo sits and goes. Inside a profile or the story viewer the search looks past views that hold no media, like the story viewer's clear tap layer. Above a profile's root it looks past only views that draw nothing at the fingers (Facebook keeps an empty layer over every screen) and stops at anything that does. A Litho host found first gives way to a picture right under it that spans all of it, like the band a profile's cover draws over its photo. Pages opened from a link run in an activity whose dispatchTouchEvent goes through a delegate, and that delegate calls back into FbFragmentActivity's, so the one call covers them too.

Written for Hushfacebook: Skip silent parts, for issue #144, from Facebook 582. Each of the two ExoPlayer copies Facebook ships has a DefaultAudioSink that hands its processor chain, a field of its own, the skip-silence flag and then calls the kept-name AudioSink.Listener method onSkipSilenceEnabledChanged. The patch finds each method calling that name after handing one boolean to such a chain, asks the extension for the flag into a register nothing reads there, and hands the chain that answer, leaving the sink's stored flag alone. The listener's own dispatch, which hands nothing on, is left out. The extension answers yes while its switch is on.

Written for Hushfacebook: Keep feed videos muted, a Reddit request, from Facebook 583. Facebook's feed sound state is the one class with a kept-name startNewSession method, which hands a flag to a setter of its own taking a reason enum and a flag. The same class has one setter taking that reason, a String and a flag, which first reads the sound flag both setters store and compares it with the one it's asked for. The patch asks the extension for the session setter's flag before anything reads it, and for the reasoned setter's flag right after its read, each answer going back in the flag's own register. While the switch is on a new session starts muted, and a sound-on whose reason name doesn't start with BY_USER, and that doesn't come through onKeyUp or the kept-name maybeUnmuteOnDeviceVolumeIncrease, keeps the flag the state holds.

Written for Hushfacebook: Upload Stories in HD, for issue #123, from Facebook 582. The publisher's kept Kotlin internal name getUploadOperationForCreate builds a new post's UploadOperation, and for a post bound only for a Story it puts each video's upload quality into a Bundle under video_upload_quality. Facebook's video uploader passes only high on to the upload server as its encoding hint. The patch finds that one putString, asks the extension for the value into the value's own register right before it, and leaves the rest of the method alone. The extension answers high while its switch is on and keeps Facebook's raw.

Written for Hushfacebook: Longer music on photo stories, for issue #156, from Facebook 584. The Story composer's music clip length is the one static method taking FbUserSession and the composer state, answering an int, that asks the composer configuration for its FeedAttachmentConfig and holds 30000 and 15000. For a photo it returns a MobileConfig double turned into an int when that is above zero, else 15000. The patch asks the extension right before both of those returns, into the returned register, and leaves the rest of the method alone. The extension answers at least 30000 while its switch is on.

Written for Hushfacebook: the switch on liking a reel or a video with a double tap. The patch finds, in Facebook 577 and 580, the reel like helper by its kept trace FbShortsMutationUtil.mutateViewerLikeReaction, its double-tap like as its one instance method taking two objects and a boolean, GestureReactionComponent by the name its constructor gives it, that component's gesture view through onCreateMountContent, the view's heart by the shortFormVideoUnit key it logs, and the feed attachment's own double tap as the one onDoubleTap animating translationY. It hands the extension the gesture view's double-tap handler after every read of it, the double-tap like's key for the reel, the helper like's source and the attachment's double tap. While the switch is on the extension answers that there's no handler and no key, holds back a like whose source is DOUBLE_TAP and leaves the attachment's double tap unhandled, and otherwise hands back what Facebook handed over.
